arrivals.motivation: Helvetica calls the seals public law. I came to see whether the Hearth protects people or merely celebrates victories.
arrivals.calendar_text: Ulric Crowe arrives as a Heltic civic observer—and asks to sign the same dangerous contract as everyone else.

arrivals.motivation: The Concord says the prison is poisoning land that never consented to contain it. I will heal people, but I also intend to heal the wound beneath them.
arrivals.calendar_text: Rhea Hart follows refugees from the Cinder Fields and brings the Verdant Concord's accusation against the prison itself.

arrivals.motivation: The Veiled Isles keep records of spirits the empires renamed as monsters. I want to know whose name the Crypt Lord was guarding.
arrivals.calendar_text: Tamsin Kestrel arrives with an Isles funerary token and a forbidden version of the Crypt's history.

arrivals.motivation: The Dominion accepts that Balor is dangerous. It does not accept that an ancient sentence is beyond lawful amendment.
arrivals.calendar_text: Nessa Morrow carries a Sun-Crowned writ challenging every nation that claims permanent ownership of Balor's sentence.
